# PaveDB JavaScript / TypeScript Client — API reference (v0.2.1)

Construct with `new PaveDBClient({ baseUrl, apiKey })`;
`apiKey`, `fetchImpl` and `timeoutMs` are optional. Errors throw `PaveDBError`
with `status`, `code`, and the server message.

PaveDB 0.9.7 expects `addDocument(..., { text })` (or `{ vector }`)
and `search(..., { q, k })` (or `{ v, k }`). `listDocuments` returns
the full list. `getArchive` returns the ZIP `Response`; inspect its
`X-PaveDB-Skipped-Collections` header before using the archive.

| Method | HTTP route |
|---|---|
| `health()` | `GET /health` |
| `metrics()` | `GET /metrics` |
| `version()` | `GET /health` |
| `listTenants()` | `GET /v1/admin/tenants` |
| `listEmbedders()` | `GET /v1/admin/embedders` |
| `getArchive()` | `GET /v1/admin/archive` |
| `listCollections(tenantName: string)` | `GET /v1/collections/{tenantName}` |
| `getCollectionDetail(tenantName: string, name: string)` | `GET /v1/collections/{tenantName}/{name}/detail` |
| `createCollection(tenantName: string, name: string, options?: CreateCollectionOptions)` | `POST /v1/collections/{tenantName}/{name}` |
| `deleteCollection(tenantName: string, name: string)` | `DELETE /v1/collections/{tenantName}/{name}` |
| `addDocument(tenantName: string, collection: string, body: DocumentInput)` | `POST /v1/collections/{tenantName}/{collection}/documents` |
| `addDocuments(tenantName: string, collection: string, documents: DocumentInput[])` | `POST /v1/collections/{tenantName}/{collection}/documents:batch` |
| `getDocument(tenantName: string, collection: string, docid: string)` | `GET /v1/collections/{tenantName}/{collection}/documents/{docid}` |
| `listDocuments(tenantName: string, collection: string)` | `GET /v1/collections/{tenantName}/{collection}/documents` |
| `metricsSnapshot()` | `GET /health/metrics` |
| `search(tenantName: string, collection: string, body: SearchBody)` | `POST /v1/collections/{tenantName}/{collection}/search` |

## Notes

- `metrics` — Prometheus exposition text, not JSON.
- `version` — Server version from the always-on health endpoint.
- `getArchive` — ZIP response; inspect X-PaveDB-Skipped-Collections before using it.
- `getCollectionDetail` — Collection settings, live counts, and cumulative ingest/reuse totals.
- `addDocuments` — Batch ingest with per-document success and error results.
- `getDocument` — Document metadata and chunk ids, absent from document summaries.
- `metricsSnapshot` — Admin-key counters and hardware snapshot.
